criteria.statement: Healthy and in-sync service deployments with observed hosts are included as DNS endpoints and records.
Drifted, unhealthy, offline, unsynced, or malformed inputs are excluded from projection.
LLM routes project only when gateway status is synced and backend health is healthy.
ML endpoints project only when backend health is healthy.
Workers project only when online and RuntimeTarget.PublicBaseURL is present.
Record type derivation maps IPv4 to A, IPv6 to AAAA, and hostnames to CNAME.
Endpoint ordering and IDs are deterministic, and duplicate coordinates fail the snapshot.
DNS reconciler no-ops when actual and projected snapshots match and syncs when they differ.
